subject: Mutual action plan draft — timeline checkpoint & procurement cutoff
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan draft — timeline checkpoint & procurement cutoff

Alex — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step: I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) that lays out milestones, owners, and target dates so we can align on what 'close' will look like and ensure procurement has enough runway.

High-level items I captured from the call:
- Target program start/close: you mentioned aiming for mid-April; I proposed April 15 as a working target.
- Procurement signature cutoff: from your note about internal cycles, we think a signed contract / PO by April 1 is needed to hit April 15 start.
- Dependencies: security questionnaire completion (Lumen security team), legal SOW review, and an internal pilot approval from the data governance council.

Next step: please review the attached "Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx" — it lists milestones (Discovery complete, Security review, PO issued, SOW signed, Pilot run) with recommended owners and dates. If that looks ok, can we lock in April 1 as the sig/PO cutoff so I can start procurement coordination on our side?

If procurement needs a separate timeline for approvals, loop in procurement@lumenhealth.com and I will add a procurement-specific milestone row.

Attachments: Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_Redwood_v0.9.pdf (draft SOW)

Thanks — I can update in real-time during a short 20-min sync if you'd prefer.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft — timeline checkpoint & procurement cutoff

Thanks Camila — great summary and the MAP is a useful starting point. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- April 15 as target start is realistic, but only if legal and security sign off happen quickly.
- Procurement: our finance org has a monthly PO window. To make April 15, we need signed contract + PO input by April 1 (your cutoff aligns with that).
- Security: our InfoSec team typically needs 10 business days to complete the questionnaire + run the short architecture review. You should assume security sign-off by April 6 if we kick off the questionnaire this week.

Can you add a line in the MAP explicitly calling out "Security questionnaire start date" and "Procurement submission date" so our procurement team can track it? I've CC'd procurement@lumenhealth.com so they see the MAP and can flag any internal constraints.

I'll review the SOW and get back with redline comments by Thursday.

— Alex
Alex Jenkins
Director, Digital Platforms
Lumen Health
alex.jenkins@lumenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0129

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft — timeline checkpoint & procurement cutoff

Alex / Procurement team — thanks for the confirmation. I've updated the MAP to include the two procurement-specific rows you requested. Key updates (see attached v1.1):

- Security questionnaire start: 2026-03-05 — Owner: Lumen InfoSec (contacted today); Redwood SE point: Vivek Kulkarni.
- Security questionnaire target sign-off: 2026-04-06 — Owner: Lumen InfoSec; Redwood support: Vivek.
- Procurement submission (internal): 2026-03-29 — Owner: Procurement Team (Lumen); notes: submit contract to finance for PO cycle ending 2026-04-01.
- Contract signature / PO issued: 2026-04-01 — Owner: Lumen Finance / Procurement; Redwood legal to provide final SOW and signature pages by 2026-03-26.
- Target program start (production pilot): 2026-04-15 — Owner: Lumen Product; Redwood pilot lead: Rishi Malhotra.

Milestone table (excerpt):
1) Discovery complete — 2026-03-10 — Owner: Lumen Product / Camila (Redwood)
2) Security questionnaire submitted — 2026-03-05 — Owner: Lumen InfoSec
3) Security sign-off — 2026-04-06 — Owner: Lumen InfoSec / Vivek (Redwood)
4) Procurement submit (to finance) — 2026-03-29 — Owner: Lumen Procurement
5) Contract signed & PO issued — 2026-04-01 — Owner: Lumen Finance / Redwood Legal
6) Pilot kickoff — 2026-04-15 — Owner: Lumen Product / Rishi (Redwood)

Action items for this thread:
- Alex / Procurement: confirm procurement submission date and whether procurement prefers DocuSign or internal signature workflow.
- Vivek (SE): I flagged a technical deliverable on the MAP for an architecture runbook; can you confirm delivery ETA so we can add it as a dependency?
- Rishi (CS): confirm resource availability for pilot (2 FTEs for 3 weeks) starting 4/15.

Attachments (v1.1): Lumen_MAP_v1.1.xlsx, SOW_Redwood_v0.9.pdf

I can host a 20-min call Thursday 3/5 to walk procurement/security through the MAP if that helps.

Best,
Camila

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 17:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft — timeline checkpoint & procurement cutoff

Thanks Camila — quick confirm from my side: Redwood can commit the pilot staffing as outlined (2 FTEs for a 3-week pilot) and Rishi will be the pilot lead. Vivek — I'll rely on you for the architecture runbook; please aim to have a draft by 2026-03-20 so legal and security can reference it.

Alex / Procurement — happy to work with whichever signing mechanism your finance team prefers. If April 1 is tight, propose we prioritize getting the SOW and signature pages finalized by 2026-03-26 so procurement has the final documents for submission.

I'll drop a short checklist in the MAP under the procurement row: required attachments (final SOW, pricing exhibit, MSA signature page).

Rishi Malhotra
